metadata.description: Articles and resolutions of your organisation, in one private place.

validation.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens (e.g. annual-report-2026).
validation.urlInvalid: Enter an https:// address or upload a file.
validation.translationRequired: Fill in at least one language.
validation.optionLabelRequired: Enter this option in every language the resolution is written in.
validation.passwordUnchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.

signIn.title: Sign in

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: You'll be signed out on all your devices.

errors.email_not_verified: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Check your inbox or request a new link.

verify.subject: Confirm your email – Consensia
verify.heading: Confirm your email
verify.body: Thanks for signing up. Confirm your email address to activate your account.

verify.ignore: If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your password – Consensia
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account.
reset.expires: The link is valid for 1 hour.

resolutionOpened.subject: Voting is open: {title}
resolutionOpened.preview: A new resolution is waiting for your vote: {title}

resolutionOpened.noDeadline: Voting stays open until a moderator closes it.

emailChange.subject: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.preview: One click to start using this address in Consensia.

emailChange.body: A request was made from your Consensia account to use this address from now on. Open the link and confirm to finish the change.
emailChange.expires: The link is valid for 24 hours.
emailChange.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Nothing will change.

emailChanged.subject: Your Consensia email address was changed
emailChanged.heading: Email address changed
emailChanged.body: Your account now uses {email}. Messages will no longer be sent to this address.
emailChanged.warning: If you did not make this change, contact your administrator immediately.

resolutionReminder.subject: Reminder: vote on {title}
